topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Well, now, there's something you don’t see every day. Found a bit of parchment roll in the barn, hid under a manger, tied up with a bit of string. Was a right read, it was. All sorts of things Mistress had written down, places she wants to see, things she wants to do. Things like walking to the far hills and seeing the sea, which I’ve heard tell of but never seen myself. And she wants to taste wine from the south, and dance in a grand hall. Don’t know as I’ve ever seen her so much as skip, let alone dance. Makes a man wonder what all this means, if there's more to life than the soil and the sweat.
